title: B8.4 synthetic submission (PROVISIONAL)
description: One fictional submission in the form of PRD B1.5: online text with Repository:, Demo: and Report: lines, and, when the online text has no Report: section, a report file. The repository and the report stay as files so the set can be reviewed. How a reader extracts the parts is B1.5 and the shared vectors in contracts/test-vectors/submission.v1.json.

onlinetext.description: The learner's online text, exactly as the reader gets it (B1.5). Links are placeholders on reserved .invalid hosts (RFC 2606); the publish step replaces them with lab addresses.

onlinetext_format.description: Only plain text. Editor HTML is not used until the lab check on Moodle 4.5 and 5.3 (B1.5 rule 5 is unverified).

files.description: Uploaded files in this submission's folder. Only a report file is used, and only when the online text has no Report: section (B1.5 rule 4).

hosting.description: What the (future) publish step must set up so the machine checks give the intended result.

publish_repo.description: false: the repository is not published, so the repository link does not clone.

demo_stub.description: answers: a stub page that answers the test question; unrelated_page: returns HTTP 200 with unrelated content; none: nothing is served.
